description: List the Pokémon Champions regulations this connector supports, with each one's id, dates, whether it is current, team rules, number of legal Mega Evolutions and whether usage statistics are available. Use it to find the `format` value other tools accept and to see which format they use by default.
name: list_formats

defaultFormat.description: Format used when a tool's `format` is omitted

status.description: Where today falls relative to the regulation's dates

usageStats.description: Whether usage statistics are published for the regulation. Does not guarantee the latest month is loaded

title: List supported formats
